intro.problem_solved: 解决多模型接入分散、权限与预算难以统一管控的问题，并可将生产流量转化为定制路由或微调模型。

evidence: A rulebook that stops an AI coding agent shipping generic UI, text, and AI-shaped code.
40 mandatory rules (R-01 to R-40) in three tiers: Hard Gate, Purpose-Gate, and Quality Locks.
The core prevents slop but cannot invent direction. `DESIGN.md` (yours) supplies it

HyNetworks/tcp-brutal.one_liner: TCP 拥塞控制内核模块

intro.one_liner: TCP 拥塞控制模块
intro.what_it_is: 一个用 C 编写的 Linux 内核模块，把 Hysteria 的 Brutal 拥塞控制算法移植到 TCP，并提供速率规则管理工具。
intro.problem_solved: 让发送端按已知带宽设定固定发送速率，无需应用适配或接收端配合，也能让多条连接共享一个速率上限。
intro.who_should_care: 运维代理服务、管理 Linux 服务器传输速率，或开发 TCP 网络程序的开发者。
use_cases: 为服务器下载流量设定速率
让代理多连接共享带宽
在套接字上启用指定速率
intro.alternatives: 不探测带宽，而是按设定速率发包；与 cubic 或 BBR 的探测方式不同。
intro.hype_or_trend: 短期热点，一周涨了 1,093 星且曾上日榜。
intro.risk_notes: 需要 Linux 5.10 或更高版本；规则重启后不保留；速率设得过高只会产生丢包；不宜设为系统默认拥塞控制。
evidence: TCP Brutal is [Hysteria](https://hysteria.network/)'s congestion control algorithm ported to TCP, as a Linux kernel module.

**New in v2:** TCP Brutal no longer needs special support from the application. Set a rate for a destination once, and every connection to it uses Brutal, any program, any TCP-based protocol. Stop waiting and use it right now!

**Brutal sends at the rate you set.** It does not probe for bandwidth like cubic or BBR. It paces packets at the configured rate, and when packets are lost it sends more so that the delivered rate stays at the target. This assumes you know the bandwidth of the path; set it too high and you only produce loss.
